title: Enforce the control-plane boundary at the validator step
summary: Protected paths are checked deterministically for every orchestrated node that targets this repository, from the policy file in the trusted running checkout (not the candidate worktree), with a hard-coded floor if the policy is missing. Only the operator can grant paths (run policy protected_paths_allowed). Limitation: work done outside Orchestrator (a human-driven agent session) is not intercepted; policy text, `orchestrate control-check` and Git review cover that path.
